name: Sonatel Rufisque Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute record confirms Data Center Sonatel Rufisque (Route de Rufisque, Rufisque dept, Dakar region); Sonatel 2020 annual report cites TCCF Tier III DOF Constructed Facility certification. Ecofin Agency reported Sonatel added a second room to the Rufisque DC. Operational incumbent-operator facility; no public IT-load MW found.

name: SENUM Datacenter National de Diamniadio (national government data center)
notes: SENUM official page lists Diamniadio among three operational state datacenters (Orana, Technopole, Diamniadio). Inaugurated 22 June 2021 by President Macky Sall at the Diamniadio Digital Technology Park; press cites 500-1,000 sqm technical/hosting space and ~1.4 MW (B-grade). AidData project 73114 describes a Tier 3 state data center (~1,000 TB) built with Chinese-loan finance and Huawei support. Capacity field is a B-grade press figure, not an official SENUM technical sheet.

name: SENUM Orana datacenter
notes: SENUM official page lists Orana among three operational state datacenters. No public locality, capacity or function detail found in this pass; state-operator DC name is A-grade, facility class (full hosting DC vs server room) unverified.

name: SENUM Technopole datacenter
notes: SENUM official page lists Technopole among three operational state datacenters; SENUM contact address is at the Technopole, Pikine (Dakar region). No public capacity; function (public hosting vs internal state DC) unverified.

name: Senelec Datacenter Diamniadio
notes: Uptime Institute award record for Senelec Datacenter Diamniadio (A). Inaugurated 20 July 2022 by the Minister of Petroleum and Energy (Forum RSE, B); press describes Tier III certification. Utility/internal facility; kept separate from the SENUM national DC per methodology.

name: Douanes BdM Datacenter
notes: Uptime Institute record for Douanes, BdM Datacenter, Dakar (A; ICTworks lists it under Direction Generale des Douanes, Dakar). Likely internal government/customs facility; no commercial colocation evidence found.

name: Yas Diamniadio Data Center (ex-SenConnect/Tigo, ex-Free)
developer: Yas / Axian Telecom (originally SenConnect for Tigo/Millicom)
notes: Uptime record names Tigo Senegal Dakar DC Phase-1A; press (Lejecos, CIO Mag) report the SenConnect-built Diamniadio DC as the first Uptime Tier 3 certified facility in francophone Africa, inaugurated by Tigo Business. DataCenterMap (C) lists current owner Yas (Axian Telecom) at QR27+VPX, Diamniadio (Rufisque dept, Dakar region). Operational.

name: Free Senegal Diamniadio data centre (Tier III)
notes: AXIAN group release (May 2022) states Free will build/operate Avanti's HYLAS 4 gateway from its Tier III data centre facility in Diamniadio; Satnews (May 2023) confirms the gateway's second phase completed and hosted at Free's Tier III Diamniadio facility; Avanti secured HYLAS 4 gateway authorisation Mar 2024 (Avanti page). The Avanti gateway is tenant evidence at Free's DC, not a separate facility.

name: Onix Data Centre Senegal
developer: Onix Data Centres Ltd / La Colombe Group
notes: DCD (Feb 2023) reported Onix launched colocation in Dakar at the 2Africa cable landing station in Almadies (access to ACE/MainOne/2Africa); DCD later notes Onix operates two facilities (Accra launched 2017, Dakar 2023). Operator stated advanced-stage Uptime Tier 3 design certification with Q4 2023 completion target (LinkedIn). Carrier-neutral Tier 3 colo; no public MW found.

name: PAIX Dakar (DKR-1)
notes: PAIX broke ground Jan 2025 in Les Mamelles/Ouakam, Dakar; 918 sqm white space, 1.2 MW critical power, ~330 racks, ~USD 10M; first phase planned operational 2026 (DCD, DCmag, operator page). No 2026 go-live or current services page found in this pass, so status remains construction per methodology.

name: StellarIX Senegal
notes: Operator claims colocation/cloud in a Tier III Design & Facility Diamniadio datacenter (A for service/location claim; Uptime certification unverified). DataCenterMap (C) places it in Sangalkam/Diamniadio. No independent operating status or capacity evidence found; status unknown.

name: Jokko / Dariss Consulting sovereign cloud (Senegal-hosted)
notes: Provider claims a Senegal sovereign cloud hosted in a Tier III+ Dakar datacenter (A for provider claim; C/B for the unnamed host facility and Tier III+ claim, which has no Uptime record). Service-level record, not a standalone facility.

name: N+One Senegal data centres (Digital Technology Park programme)
developer: N+One Datacenters (Morocco) / Senegal Digital Technology Park
notes: DCD (Apr 2021) reported N+One would build three data centers in Dakar under a partnership tied to Senegal's Digital Technology Park / Digital Senegal plan; Africa Intelligence (Mar 2023) reports N+One won a contract to equip a data centre under the Digital Technology Park project. No completion/operational evidence found in this pass; status announced/contract stage.

name: SENUM Kaolack data center (planned)
notes: A Senegal Numerique SA offers post (LinkedIn pulse) states the data-centre service is available at Orana, Technopole and Diamniadio and 'bientot a Kaolack' - a planned SENUM data centre in Kaolack (C-grade operator statement). Older 2021 government-intent stories also mention a Kaolack national-DC plan; no official SENUM/APIX confirmation or construction evidence found in this pass.
